note: File Download Link Media is a submodule of file_download_link. It provides one field formatter, 'file_download_link_media', for entity_reference field types whose target_type is media (isApplicable also requires the media types' source fields to be file/image). It renders each referenced media by viewing the media's source field through the parent 'file_download_link' formatter, so its settings (link_text default 'Download', link_title, aria_label, new_tab, rel_attribute, force_download, force_download_filename, custom_classes; schema field.formatter.settings.file_download_link_media) mirror the parent. No configure route, permissions, or Drush. Requires media + file_download_link. Introspection reads a live media-reference display's formatter + link_text; execution switches a media reference field's formatter to file_download_link_media and changes its link_text, verified against the live entity_view_display. Cases use a namespaced media reference field (field_fdlm_*) on Article.

evals.prompt: What does the file_download_link_media submodule add, and which kind of field is it for?
evals.expected_output: It adds a field formatter, 'file_download_link_media', for entity_reference fields that target Media, rendering the referenced media as a download link to its source file/image.

evals.prompt: When is the file_download_link_media formatter available to choose in Manage display?
evals.expected_output: isApplicable() offers it only when the reference field's target_type is 'media' and the referenced media types have source fields of type file and/or image.

evals.prompt: How does file_download_link_media actually render the download link, and which module does it rely on?
evals.expected_output: It loads each referenced media, finds its source field, and renders that field through the parent file_download_link formatter (->view(['type' => 'file_download_link', 'label' => 'hidden', 'settings' => $this->getSettings()])). It requires the media and file_download_link modules; settings mirror the parent.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a Media reference field displayed with the file_download_link_media formatter and a custom link text. Inspect the live default display and state the configured link text.
On this Drupal site, inspect the Article content type's default display for the media reference field named field_fdlm_probe and state which field formatter renders it.
evals.expected_output: field_fdlm_probe is rendered with the file_download_link_media formatter in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a Media reference field 'field_fdlm_task' currently shown as an entity reference label. Using the file_download_link_media module, change its default display so it renders as a File Download Link (media). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_fdlm_task component type is set to 'file_download_link_media'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article media reference field 'field_fdlm_link' is already displayed with the File Download Link (media) formatter. Change its link text to 'Download Media' and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: The field_fdlm_link component keeps type file_download_link_media and its settings.link_text is set to 'Download Media'.
